muscles.note: Inner-thigh panels: the small front panel beside the vastus medialis and the rear ovals (adductor magnus / gracilis). The drawing cannot separate pectineus, adductor longus, gracilis and magnus, so the label stays a group.

muscles.name: Back of knee (popliteal region)

muscles.name: Achilles tendon region
muscles.note: Narrow lower part of the central calf shape, from the soleus junction to the heel; a tendon, not a muscle.

muscles.name: Patellar tendon / upper shin region
anatomicalNames: Patellar ligament and upper anterior shin region
muscles.note: Region below the kneecap; not a muscle (the gastrocnemius arises behind the knee). Excluded from muscle selection by default.
